text.en: In Sakhalin Ainu, non-phonemic epenthetic vowels appear in pronunciation and are inserted in transcription to improve readability, as in *'omanu wa 'isam* ⟦claim:phon/citation-vs-combining-stem-shapes--nonphonemic-epenthetic-vowels-sakhalin⟧.
text.ja: 樺太アイヌ語では、音韻論的ではない介在母音が発音において現れ、可読性のために*'omanu wa 'isam*のように表記上にも挿入される⟦claim:phon/citation-vs-combining-stem-shapes--nonphonemic-epenthetic-vowels-sakhalin⟧。
